message: Hey John, just a heads-up, the Thompson Family Reunion venue has been confirmed for March 15th at the Lakeside Park!
John, don't forget Uncle George's birthday next week. We're planning a small surprise party.
Morning John! Lily's turning 30 this Friday. Let's make her day special!
John, I heard the news about you will be the godfather of your friend's expected baby. Congratulations!
Can you believe it? Sarah is pregnant!!! Although she said it's a secret but it's such an amazing news. I cannot believe I still view her as a kid herself. Time flies!
Aunt Martha: Any family updates, folks?
John, please remind me to book the caterer for the reunion.
Did you get the reunion invites printed? We need to send them out by next week.
John, I'm so excited for the reunion! It's been too long since we all got together.
Hey, are we still on for the planning meeting tomorrow?
